reason: The Number of invoices before ending field has autocomplete="garbage", which is not a valid token, but it holds a count for the invoice series, not information about the user, so 1.3.5 does not apply to it. It exposes role textbox and a full name.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose applies only to fields that collect information about the user and serve one of the purposes in its Input Purposes list. A number of invoices before a series ends is not on that list, so no token is required and an invalid one breaks nothing. 4.1.1 Parsing is gone from WCAG 2.2. No other A or AA criterion covers an invalid autocomplete token.
